_note: Design DNA for KESTREL moto garage, a made-up motorcycle brand (student project).

thesis.visual: Daylight workshop: a garage bay on a sunny afternoon. Concrete floor, paper, masking tape, hazard stripes, painted bay lines and dealer hang tags; ink type. Colourful: every section has its own loud accent (orange hero/workbench/crew, blue lift, pink lineup and marquee, teal service, violet heritage, yellow garage) for fills and buttons, with a dark shade of the same hue for text. Wide italic display type that leans forward like a rider in a tuck. Ride mode is the night run: dark paddock with a cyan neon grid.
thesis.interaction: Throttle feel. Things are still, then snap forward fast and settle (expo out, small overshoot). The visitor drives the motion: drag, hold, throw, scroll. Only the backdrop idles (drifting light shafts and dust); content never loops for decoration except the speed marquee, whose speed is set by scroll velocity.
allowed_patterns: lineup grid of model cards (one per model family, filtered)
scrolling marquee of model family names (speed tied to scroll velocity)
bike silhouette riding the scroll progress bar
custom wheel cursor on fine pointers
intro loader styled as a tachometer
bloom glow on the 3D headlight and taillight only
CSS-only textures: concrete noise (SVG feTurbulence), pegboard holes, masking tape labels, perforated service tickets, hazard stripe dividers
lively backdrop: slow light shafts, roller-door light band and tyre tracks tied to scroll, ~60 dust motes (paused off screen, when hidden, and static under reduced motion)
3D bay: concrete ground with painted yellow bay lines and a soft shadow; Ride fades the scene to night
one accent per section, set by overriding --color-accent* on the section
forbidden: perpetual idle animation on content (the background layer is the only exception)

accent.usage: default accent (hero, workbench, crew): fills, buttons, active states (ink text on it); dark shade for text, links, focus rings

night.usage: Ride mode panels and 3D scene; cyan #2fd4ff grid and part glow, pink #ff4f9a rim light

section_accents.rule: ink on every fill >= 5:1; every text shade >= 4.5:1 on concrete and paper

typography.display: Archivo 900 italic, font-stretch 125%, uppercase, tight leading 0.9

motion.reduced_motion: gsap.matchMedia: no pins, no scrub, no loader sweep, static 3D

visual_effects.webgl: Three.js r160 procedural sport bike: PBR clearcoat paint, RoomEnvironment reflections, UnrealBloom on lights, custom shader ground (day: concrete bay with painted lines, night: scrolling cyan neon grid), day/night palette blend on Ride, exhaust particles, wheelie keyframe clip.
visual_effects.scroll: ScrollTrigger: pinned heritage road (DrawSVG + MotionPath rider), velocity-driven marquee, progress-bar rider.
visual_effects.interaction: OrbitControls drag, hold-to-rev with Web Audio engine note, raycast click for wheelie, Draggable + Inertia throwable bike, Flip filtering, ScrambleText titles.
visual_effects.performance_tier: medium: one WebGL canvas, rendering paused when off screen
